overall_goal: Cook the uttapam pancake by pressing and flipping it in the pan

goals.description: Press and flip the pancake to cook the first side
goals.rationale: The person picks up the spatula, presses the pancake, flips it, and presses the vegetables into the surface.

goals.description: Flip and press the pancake again to ensure even cooking
goals.rationale: The person picks up the spatula again, flips the pancake over, and presses it to cook evenly on all sides.
